findings.summary: R1 milestone mapping includes M2 but M2 deliverables do not address R1; R1 is fully satisfied in M1 and should not appear in M2 milestone list.

evidence.note: R1 requires accepting input folder and discovering .md files recursively.
evidence.quote: The system MUST accept a user-specified folder ... and recursively discover Markdown (.md) files

evidence.note: M1 DL2 delivers CLI skeleton that accepts input/output paths and produces static output, satisfying R1.
evidence.quote: Monolithic CLI skeleton (C1) that accepts input/output paths ... (R1, R2, R4, R11)

evidence.note: M2 focuses on forward links and backlinks; no deliverables address file discovery or R1.
evidence.quote: Generate + Validate (Thin Slice 2): Forward links + backlink computation and rendering

findings.summary: R2 milestone mapping includes M2 but M2 deliverables do not address static-site output generation; R2 is fully satisfied in M1 and should not appear in M2 milestone list.

evidence.note: R2 requires generating static website output with no server-side runtime.
evidence.quote: The system MUST generate a static website output consisting only of static files

evidence.note: M1 DL2 delivers static output folder generation, satisfying R2.
evidence.quote: produces a static output folder with one HTML page per note (R1, R2, R4, R11)

evidence.note: M2 focuses on links and backlinks; no deliverables address static-site output constraint.
evidence.quote: Forward links + backlink computation and rendering

findings.summary: R3 milestone mapping includes M2 but M2 deliverables do not address Markdown rendering or formatting preservation; R3 is fully satisfied in M1 and should not appear in M2 milestone list.

evidence.note: R3 requires parsing and rendering Markdown with preserved formatting.
evidence.quote: The system MUST parse and render each input Markdown file ... while preserving Markdown formatting and structure

evidence.note: M1 DL3 delivers Markdown rendering pipeline that preserves formatting, satisfying R3.
evidence.quote: Markdown rendering pipeline (C2+C6) that preserves core formatting/structure (R3)

evidence.note: M2 focuses on link extraction and backlinks; no deliverables address Markdown rendering.
evidence.quote: Internal link extraction and normalization ... backlink computation
